report.verdict: A mid-market Customer Success Manager with a clear account book, but no renewal results to compare with this posting.
write_up: Your resume tells a clear customer success story: you moved from payroll support into managing mid-market accounts at Brightline Payroll Software. A recruiter can see the book you manage and the work you do with customers. For this posting, the big unanswered question is how your book performed at renewal.

The onboarding checklist is a good model: you built a named resource and show that the whole CS team uses it. Your 94% customer satisfaction score also gives the earlier support work a concrete result.

Start with the at-risk account line and add what you and Sales did, plus any renewal results you can substantiate. Then bring your Gainsight and Salesforce experience forward for this application. Keep the account-book and checklist lines prominent.

cards.line: Partnered with Sales on renewal strategy for at-risk accounts
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see who you worked with, but not what went into the renewal strategy or what happened to those accounts. That matters for a role accountable for retention.
cards.example: Partnered with Sales on renewal strategy for at-risk accounts by [action], with [renewal results]
cards.question: What did you do with Sales for at-risk accounts, and what renewal results can you substantiate?

cards.line: Built an onboarding checklist now used by the whole CS team
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It names something you made and shows who uses it, without making a recruiter guess what the work produced.

cards.line: Answered client questions by phone and email
cards.cannot_tell: The channels are clear, but the questions could cover almost anything. Naming the subjects would show what clients relied on you for.
cards.example: Answered small business client questions about [topics] by phone and email
cards.question: What kinds of questions did those clients bring to you?

fit.why: Your headline and current role both center on managing mid-market software accounts.
fit.level: mid-level, manages a book of 48 mid-market accounts
fit.note: Your payroll software background, customer reviews and work with Sales give you relevant experience for this application. Put the tools and customer work closest to the posting near the top, using details you can substantiate.
